network: NASA Deep Space Network, 70-m antennas (one per complex)
source: DSN Telecommunications Link Design Handbook 810-005, Module 301, Rev. P (Coverage and Geometry), issue date 2026-05-22, Table 5: Geodetic Coordinates for DSN Stations With Respect to the WGS 84 Ellipsoid
horizons: JPL Horizons has these antennas as predefined Earth sites (CENTER='DSS-14@399', 'DSS-43@399', 'DSS-63@399'). Their site coordinates, as printed in the Horizons header, match Table 5 to the last published digit (checked 2026-11-14).
step_note: Moon rise/set at the stations changes elevation by about 12-15 deg per hour, and crossings are interpolated linearly. Measured 2026-11-14 for 2030-07-01 + 30 d: DSN union coverage 60 min 0.9909 vs 10 min 0.9913 (|delta| 0.0003) at 10 deg, 0.0010 at 20 deg, both below the 0.005 tolerance, so 60 min is used. bin/validate.php repeats the check.
